scope_items.item: With the append request mocked to return Wasabi's NoSuchKey response, object_append PUTs the text to that key and returns created: true, and reading the key back returns that text.
object_append to an existing key still appends: original text followed by new text, and the result has created: false.

scope_items.item: Append errors other than NoSuchKey (e.g. AccessDenied) don't trigger the PUT fallback and come back as clear tool errors.
If the fallback PUT fails, report it as PutObject failed: ...
The tool description says a missing key is created, and has one line about the possible race with a concurrent writer.
A live-marked test in tests/live/ appends to a new key and checks the object is created; skipped unless WASABI_LIVE=1.
rest.signed_s3 exposes the error code via an optional ToolRefused.code without changing the message.

edge_cases.description: bucket_region is not wrapped by the NoSuchKey try/except, so its own ToolRefused passes through unchanged
Read-only mode and the 1 MiB limit are still enforced before any request, including the fallback PUT
Fallback PUT failure surfaces as PutObject failed, not masked as an append error
Concurrent writer racing with the fallback PUT (no conditional create on Wasabi); accepted by the architect and documented
Result shape is identical for both paths (created always present)
